message: feat(items): compact centered comparisons and explicit quantity merchant sales
purpose: Retain the integrated targeting, density, nonlinear advancement and support-XP repairs plus newer foundry assets. Add read-only per-stat equipment comparisons even for locked/banked gear, signed color-coded deltas, all actual blockers in red, centered compact cards and bounded generic tooltips. Add a dedicated merchant selling page, validated typed quantities, full-stack selling and exact shared client/server quotes. Keep server ownership, proximity, merchant category, replay, gold-cap and atomic transaction validation. Add numerical, authoritative transaction, native input/layout and rendered regression fixtures. No class or player-level requirement is invented where the game has none.
